Create a GAME-READY PIXEL ART adaptation of ONLY its main church rear courtyard, with no bottom prop-study strip. One complete 2:1 rectangular map, meant to be downsampled to 512 by 256 native pixels, displayed as clean crisp enlarged pixel art. Camera elevated orthographic, 60 degrees above ground, no horizon or perspective convergence. It must function as a scrolling Sega Mega Drive arena, not an illustration.
Composition on a logical 512x256 map: chapel and small utility building occupy ONLY the top band y0..80. Modest intact Brazilian chapel on upper left, white limewashed facade, muted blue arched doors/windows, terracotta pitched roof and single-bell gable with plain cross. Empty devotional niche because the portable Madonna was already carried away. Broad mostly EMPTY playable packed-earth and worn stone courtyard from y88 to y239, x16..495. Thin low walls at far left, far right and bottom edge. An open blue wooden escape gate at upper right of the top band with red cloth, fading bootprints toward it. Small wooden pew barricade, water jugs, rolled bedrolls and crates ONLY attached to upper perimeter or side perimeter, NEVER scattered across the center. Warm amber lamps, petrol blue and terracotta shadows, semiarid Brazilian caatinga glimpsed outside low walls. No people, no enemies, no HUD, no text, no logos, no statues.
STRICT style: authentic economical 16-bit pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, coherent 16-color-looking palette, flat readable surfaces, little fine noise. Repeatable low-detail dirt/stone floor motifs and modular 8x8-friendly wall/roof patterning; large color blocks that can deduplicate into fewer than 600 native8x8 tiles. No antialias, no blur, no tiny photoreal noise. All objects registered on the same ground plane. Keep the center readable for combat. Complete opaque scene filling the canvas, no extra border, no empty black surrounds. Preserve the intact chapel and environmental evidence of an evacuation from the reference. Request output aspect ratio exactly2:1.
